field_of_view_deg: Per imager 37 to 104 H (73 to 28 V)

power.method: PoE++ (IEEE 802.3bt Type 4 Class 8 90W, or Type 3 Class 6 60W), 24/36 VDC or 24 VAC

storage.notes: Dual microSD (SDHC/SDXC) slots, up to 3 TB; mirror, failover or extend modes.

features: Four independent 5MP imagers on one IP address
Modular design: combine with a PTZ, panoramic or fixed camera in the center
Motorized 3.2-8.1 mm AVF lenses, 3-axis imager adjustment
Integrated surround IR (850 nm), 30 m, 4 controllable zones
IVA Pro Buildings, IVA Pro Perimeter, Camera Trainer
Built-in MEMS microphone, audio line in/out
Optional SFP fiber with fiber mounts
release_notes: Specs per official IQSIGHT (formerly Bosch Video Systems) datasheet (nmm_7703_al_ds_en_data_sheet_enus_180543751691.pdf), linked from the IQSIGHT product page. Sensitivity measured per IEC 62676 Part 5. Power 38.1 W max at 24 VAC (36.3 W PoE/VDC), standalone with NDA-7050-M. Datasheet compliance line lists NDAA for the North/Latin America model (ndaa_compliant left unset per project convention). The product page key specs state 1/2.7-inch sensors; the datasheet states 1/2.8-inch (used here).

frigate.notes: Bosch official RTSP scheme: /?inst=1 main, /?inst=2 sub (per Bosch 'RTSP usage with Bosch Video IP Devices'). Default admin user is 'service' (no factory default password — set one first). ONVIF Profile S/G (T/M on INTEOX). Not individually bench-tested.

home_assistant.notes: Generic ONVIF integration; Bosch CPP cameras are ONVIF Profile S/G compliant. Use the 'service' account.

blue_iris.notes: Bosch — use the ONVIF/RTSP (or 'Bosch') profile; default admin user is 'service'.
